title: ios-shortcuts build spec
description: Input for scripts/build_shortcut.py — compiles to an unsigned .shortcut plist.

name.description: Shortcut name (WFWorkflowName). If omitted in the plist, the file name is used on import.

minimumClientVersion.description: WFWorkflowMinimumClientVersion. 900 = broad compat (iOS 14+). >=1100 means iOS 15+, which requires a signed file to import.

types.description: WFWorkflowTypes, e.g. ["ActionExtension"] to show in the share sheet, ["NCWidget"] for widgets.

inputClasses.description: WFWorkflowInputContentItemClasses, e.g. WFStringContentItem, WFURLContentItem, WFImageContentItem, WFGenericFileContentItem.

actions.description: Ordered actions. Text fields support {name} placeholders referencing an earlier action's "as", and {input} for Shortcut Input. Input fields accept "{name}", "$input"/"{input}", "$var:Name", or a raw plist dict.

as.description: Names this action's output so later text fields can use {name}.

identifier.description: raw: full action identifier, e.g. is.workflow.actions.gettext

parameters.description: raw: full WFWorkflowActionParameters dict (UUID is added automatically).

inputType.description: ask: Text, Number, URL, Date, Time, ...

operation.description: calculate: +, -, *, / (translated to the Unicode operators Shortcuts expects)

key.description: getdict: dictionary key, dot paths allowed

condition.description: if: WFCondition code — 0 <, 1 <=, 2 >, 3 >= (numeric, WFNumberValue); 4 is, 5 is not, 8 begins with, 9 ends with, 99 contains, 999 does not contain (string, WFConditionalActionString); 100 has any value, 101 no value; 1002 is today, 1003 between

compare.description: if: comparison value — string goes to WFConditionalActionString, number to WFNumberValue

group.description: control flow: explicit GroupingIdentifier shared by if/else/endif, menu/case/endmenu, repeat/endrepeat
